style_guidance: Lead with direct, relatable hooks that create immediate recognition ('You walk into the kitchen...', 'Try it right now...'). Focus on curiosity-gap educational content about everyday body phenomena rather than serious disease states or personal updates. Avoid giving away the answer in the caption opening - tease the 'why' to drive engagement and saves.
